035/**
036 * The updater is the main handler of the update cycle. It contains the hard
037 * coded bits of the update cycle and configurable aspects can be added with
038 * person processors and outbreak processors which can be created with
039 * {@link #withPersonProcessor(Predicate, TriConsumer)} or
040 * {@link #withOutbreakProcessor(Predicate, TriConsumer)} and pre-canned update
041 * configurations are found in the {@link ModelUpdate} class.
042 *
043 * <br>
044 * <br>
045 * Within the update process at each time step the contact network is determined
046 * by the {@link #contactNetwork(Outbreak)} method. This is the key determinant
047 * of exposures, from social network connections and, if supported, venue driven
048 * connections.
049 *
050 * <br>
051 * <br>
052 * The updater follows the following process:
053 * <ul>
054 * <li><u>prepareUpdate:</u> Creates a Ephemeral OutbreakState and PersonState
055 * builder in Outbreak and each Person respectively, from the current state.
056 * This will be used to process state changes and will become the current state
057 * at the next time point. Similarly creates a OutbreakHistory and PersonHistory
058 * builder from the current states, using
059 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.abm.HistoryMapper HistoryMapper}. These will become
060 * the historical record of the current state at the original time point. At
061 * this point the head of the history list still points to the previous day
062 * (t-1) and the current state to (t).</li>
063 * <li><u>updateHistory:</u> This stage is responsible for filling in events
064 * that can be regarded as happening at the end of the day (t). Firstly the
065 * contacts made during the day are simulated and recorded, depending on the
066 * state of the agents. Secondly updates are made to the model as defined by
067 * policy and behaviours. This mostly includes updating agents with records of
068 * the testing performed during the current day (t). This is done by the end of
069 * day function in the the behaviour state (see
070 * {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.State.BehaviourState}) which implements
071 * an <em>updateHistory</em> hook for person histories, and in the policy state
072 * (see {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.State.PolicyState}) which
073 * implements an <em>updateHistory</em> hook for outbreak histories. At the end
074 * of this stage the head of the history list points to the original previous
075 * day (t-1) and the current state is still at the original day (t).
076 *
077 * <br>
078 * The updateHistory phase first operates on the Outbreak and then on each
079 * Person in the simulation.</li>
080 * <li><u>switchHistory:</u> At this point the head of the OutbreakHistory list
081 * and PersonHistory lists are updated to point to the copy created from the
082 * current state in the last step. After this point the head of the history list
083 * points to the same day (t) as the current state (t).</li>
084 * <li><u>updateState:</u> The second phase of the updates is focussed on
085 * changes that happen at the start of the next day (t+1). For all agents their
086 * in host viral load model is updated with information about any exposures that
087 * happened in the previous day (t) and the model advanced one time step top
088 * (t+1). Similarly based on observed contacts, and their observed risks and
089 * test results the per agent risk model is updated to represent what each agent
090 * could know about their risk at time (t+1) based on information up to and
091 * including time (t). Behavioural changes are then applied using the behaviour
092 * state's {@code nextState} hook
093 * ({@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.State.BehaviourState}), and in the
094 * policy state via its {@code nextState} hook
095 * ({@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.State.PolicyState}). State
096 * implementations use the context and RNG to decide the next state and may
097 * mutate the supplied builders where necessary.
098 *
099 * <br>
100 * <br>
101 * When using this care must be taken to recognise that the first day in history
102 * is the current day that is being updated (t). After this the current state is
103 * still at time (t) and the head of the history list at time (t) - however the
104 * agents in host viral load and risk models are already updated to (t+1).
105 *
106 * <br>
107 * The updateState phase first operates on the Outbreak and then on each Person
108 * in the simulation.</li>
109 * <li><u>switchState:</u> At this point the current states of the outbreak (t)
110 * or agents is switched to point to the newly created future state representing
111 * the next day in the simulation (t+1). When this happens the simulation day
112 * counter is effectively incremented. After this point the head of an agents
113 * history list points to the previous day (t) and the current state is
114 * referring to (t+1) (including in host and risk models)</li>
115 * </ul>
116 *
117 * <img src="updater.png" alt="Updater process flow diagram">
118 */
119public class Updater {
120
121        static Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Updater.class);
122
123        /**
124         * Generate an exposure from a contact event between an potential infector
125         * and an infectee.
126         *
127         * This is where the probability of transmission is applied to determine
128         * whether a contact results in an exposure. If it does, the amount of
129         * exposure is determined by the infector's viral load. The infector is only
130         * considered if they are currently infectious, as determined by their
131         * in-host model. If the infector is not infectious, no exposure occurs
132         * regardless of the contact. If the infector is infectious, the probability
133         * of transmission is calculated by combining the infector's transmissibility
134         * and the infectee's susceptibility modifier, which are combined using an
135         * odds ratio scaling function. The resulting exposure is represented as an
136         * {@link Exposure} object, which includes the ID of the infector and the
137         * amount of exposure. If the contact does not result in an exposure, an
138         * empty Optional is returned. This method is a key part of the transmission
139         * process in the model, linking social interactions (contacts) to potential
140         * infection events (exposures).
141         *
142         * @param contact  the contact event
143         * @param infectee the person who may be infected
144         * @param infector the person who may be infectious
145         * @return an Optional containing the Exposure if transmission occurs, or
146         *         empty if not
147         */
148        public static Optional<Exposure> asExposure(
149                        Contact contact, PersonState infectee, PersonState infector
150        ) {
151
152                var sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
153
154                if (!infector.isInfectious()) return Optional.empty();
155
156                // This is where transmission rate / susceptability plays a role.
157                var trans = Conversions.scaleProbabilityByOR(
158                        infector.getAdjustedTransmissibility(),
159                        infectee.getSusceptibilityModifier()
160                );
161
162                var transmitted = sampler.bern(trans);
163                if (!transmitted) return Optional.empty();
164
165                return Optional.of(
166                        ImmutableExposure.builder()
167                                .setExposerId(
168                                        infector.getEntity()
169                                                .getId()
170                                )
171                                // Should the amount of exposure be dependent on the
172                                // probability of transmission or is this a stochastic
173                                // event? My belief is the latter. If it happens, the
174                                // dose of virus is independent of how likely it was
175                                // to happen. Probability of transmission depends on
176                                // whether contact coughs, dose depends on how much
177                                // virus they cough over you.
178                                // See PersonState#getContactExposure for where this is
179                                // picked up and fed into the in host model.
180                                .setExposure(infector.getNormalisedViralLoad())
181                                // .setTransmissionProbability(trans)
182                                .build()
183                );
184        }
185
186        /**
187         * Build the contact network for a specific outbreak day.
188         *
189         * @param outbreak the simulation
190         * @return a PersonStateContacts data structure with contacts and exposures
191         *         for every individual in the model (potentially empty).
192         */
193        public static PersonStateContacts contactNetwork(Outbreak outbreak) {
194                // Do the contact network here? and pass it as a parameter to the
195                // person updateState
196                var network = outbreak.getSocialNetwork();
197                var out = new PersonStateContacts(
198                                outbreak.getPeople()
199                                        .size(),
200                                network.size() / outbreak.getPeople()
201                                        .size() * 4
202                );
203
204                network.parallelStream()
205                        .forEach(r -> {
206                                var sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
207                                var one = r.getSource(outbreak)
208                                        .getCurrentState();
209                                var two = r.getTarget(outbreak)
210                                        .getCurrentState();
211
212                                // TODO: contacts stratified by venue such as work or school
213                                // connectedness quantile is a proxy for the context of a contact
214                                // If we wanted to control this a different set of features of the
215                                // relationship could be used. At the moment this overloads mobility
216                                // with type of contact, but in reality WORK contacts may be less
217                                // Significant that home contacts. This is where we would implement
218                                // something along these lines.
219
220                                var contactProbability = r.contactProbability(
221                                        one.getAdjustedMobility(),
222                                        two.getAdjustedMobility()
223                                );
224
225                                if (sampler.bern(contactProbability)) {
226                                        // This is a contact.
227                                        // Contact transmission probability depends on lowest
228                                        // transmissibility
229
230                                        var oneref = one.getEntity()
231                                                .getId();
232                                        var tworef = two.getEntity()
233                                                .getId();
234
235                                        var jointDetect = one.getAdjustedAppUseProbability()
236                                                        * two.getAdjustedAppUseProbability()
237                                                        * outbreak.getCurrentState()
238                                                                .getContactDetectedProbability();
239
240                                        var detected = sampler.bern(jointDetect);
241
242                                        Contact contact = ImmutableContact.builder()
243                                                .setDetected(detected)
244                                                .setParticipant1Id(oneref)
245                                                .setParticipant2Id(tworef)
246                                                // TODO: Proximity and duration of a contact aren't handled
247                                                // .setProximityDuration(contactProbability)
248                                                .build();
249
250                                        out.write(oneref)
251                                                .put(tworef, contact);
252                                        out.write(tworef)
253                                                .put(oneref, contact);
254
255                                        asExposure(contact, one, two).ifPresent(
256                                                e -> out.writeExp(oneref)
257                                                        .put(tworef, e)
258                                        );
259                                        asExposure(contact, two, one).ifPresent(
260                                                e -> out.writeExp(tworef)
261                                                        .put(oneref, e)
262                                        );
263                                }
264                        });
265
266                return out;
267
268        }

270        private List<PersonStateUpdater> personProcessors = new ArrayList<>();
271
272        private List<OutbreakStateUpdater> outbreakProcessors = new ArrayList<>();
273
274        public Updater() {
275                this.outbreakProcessors = new ArrayList<>();
276                for (ModelUpdate.OutbreakUpdaterFn value : ModelUpdate.OutbreakUpdaterFn
277                        .values()) {
278                        this.outbreakProcessors.add(value.fn());
279                }
280                this.personProcessors = new ArrayList<>();
281                for (ModelUpdate.PersonUpdaterFn value : ModelUpdate.PersonUpdaterFn
282                        .values()) {
283                        this.personProcessors.add(value.fn());
284                }
285
286        }

288        /**
289         * set the nextState builders for outbreak and each of the people, copying
290         * the current state and incrementing the time. At the same time we populate
291         * the nextHistory for outbreak and people from the current state (and
292         * current time)
293         */
294        private void prepareUpdate(Outbreak outbreak) {
295
296                if (outbreak instanceof ModifiableOutbreak) {
297                        var m = (ModifiableOutbreak) outbreak;
298
299                        m.setNextState(
300                                Ephemeral.of(
301                                        ImmutableOutbreakState.builder()
302                                                .from(m.getCurrentState())
303                                                .setTime(
304                                                        m.getCurrentState()
305                                                                .getTime() + 1
306                                                )
307                                )
308                        );
309
310                        m.setNextHistory(
311                                Ephemeral.of(
312                                        ImmutableOutbreakHistory.builder()
313                                                .from(MAPPER.createHistory(m.getCurrentState()))
314                                )
315                        );
316
317                        m.getStateMachine()
318                                .prepareUpdate();
319                }
320
321                outbreak.getPeople()
322                        .parallelStream()
323                        .forEach(person -> {
324                                if (person instanceof ModifiablePerson) {
325                                        var p = (ModifiablePerson) person;
326
327                                        p.setNextState(
328                                                Ephemeral.of(
329                                                        ImmutablePersonState.builder()
330                                                                .from(p.getCurrentState())
331                                                                .setTime(
332                                                                        p.getCurrentState()
333                                                                                .getTime() + 1
334                                                                )
335                                                                .setImmunisationDose(0D)
336                                                                .setImportationExposure(0D)
337                                                )
338                                        );
339
340                                        p.setNextHistory(
341                                                Ephemeral.of(
342                                                        ImmutablePersonHistory.builder()
343                                                                .from(MAPPER.createHistory(p.getCurrentState()))
344                                                )
345                                        );
346
347                                        p.getStateMachine()
348                                                .prepareUpdate();
349                                }
350                        });
351
352        }
353
354        /**
355         * Switches in a new state for a model by building the next state and setting
356         * the current state to the new state. Makes sure that the agents state are
357         * all also updated before updating the model state, and record the new state
358         * in the model history. This means the model history is always up to date
359         * with the current model state.
360         *
361         * <br>
362         * N.B. This is where the limit in person history length is implemented.
363         */
364        private void switchHistory(Outbreak outbreak) {
365                var limit = Math.max(
366                        outbreak.getBaseline()
367                                .getSymptomDuration(),
368                        outbreak.getBaseline()
369                                .getInfectiveDuration()
370                ) * 2;
371                if (outbreak instanceof ModifiableOutbreak) {
372                        var m = (ModifiableOutbreak) outbreak;
373                        m.getPeople()
374                                .parallelStream()
375                                .forEach(person -> {
376                                        if (person instanceof ModifiablePerson) {
377                                                var p = (ModifiablePerson) person;
378                                                // synchronized (p) {
379                                                var tmp = p.getHistory();
380                                                tmp.add(
381                                                        0,
382                                                        p.getNextHistory()
383                                                                .get()
384                                                                .build()
385                                                );
386                                                while (tmp.size() > limit) {
387                                                        tmp.remove(limit);
388                                                }
389                                                p.setNextHistory(
390                                                        p.getNextHistory()
391                                                                .clear()
392                                                );
393                                                // }
394                                        }
395                                });
396                        // synchronized (m) {
397                        m.getHistory()
398                                .add(
399                                        0,
400                                        m.getNextHistory()
401                                                .get()
402                                                .build()
403                                );
404                        m.setNextHistory(
405                                m.getNextHistory()
406                                        .clear()
407                        );
408                        // }
409                }
410        }

412        /**
413         * Switches in a new state for a model by building the next state and setting
414         * the current state to the new state. Makes sure that the agents state are
415         * all also updated before updating the model state, and record the new state
416         * in the model history. This means the model history is always up to date
417         * with the current model state
418         *
419         * @param outbreak the mutable model.
420         */
421        private void switchState(Outbreak outbreak) {
422                if (outbreak instanceof ModifiableOutbreak) {
423                        var m = (ModifiableOutbreak) outbreak;
424                        m.getPeople()
425                                .parallelStream()
426                                .forEach(person -> {
427                                        if (person instanceof ModifiablePerson) {
428                                                var p = (ModifiablePerson) person;
429                                                // synchronized (p) {
430                                                // TODO: Update spatio-temporal state network if explicit.
431                                                // This is where the new and old state co-exist
432                                                // it is one place where we could make a record in a
433                                                // spatio-temporal network. Possibly the only place.
434                                                // It would have to be thread safe and non blocking.
435                                                // alternatively we can just use the PersonHistory for this
436                                                p.setCurrentState(
437                                                        p.getNextState()
438                                                                .get()
439                                                                .build()
440                                                );
441                                                p.setNextState(
442                                                        p.getNextState()
443                                                                .clear()
444                                                );
445                                        }
446                                        // }
447                                });
448                        // synchronized (m) {
449                        m.setCurrentState(
450                                m.getNextState()
451                                        .get()
452                                        .build()
453                        );
454                        m.setNextState(
455                                m.getNextState()
456                                        .clear()
457                        );
458
459                        // }
460                }
461        }

463        /**
464         * The main update method is called to advance the simulation by one day.
465         *
466         * @param outbreak a simulation to update
467         * @return the same outbreak with new states and histories
468         */
469        public Outbreak update(Outbreak outbreak) {
470                // TODO: This is maybe Amdahl’s Law with a vengeance on 72 cores.
471                // each of these is a gate at which all
472                this.prepareUpdate(outbreak);
473                // at this point the "current history" is the same as the previous state
474                this.updateHistory(outbreak);
475                this.switchHistory(outbreak);
476                // at this point the "current history" is the same as the current state
477                this.updateState(outbreak);
478                this.switchState(outbreak);
479                // at this point the "current history" is the same as the previous state
480                log.debug(
481                        "Update: " + outbreak.getUrn() + "; Step:" + outbreak.getCurrentState()
482                                .getTime()
483                );
484                return outbreak;
485        }

487        /**
488         * The contact network is established for every person. then update the
489         * outbreak history according to the current policy. Then the person
490         * histories according to their current behaviour. This second step is where
491         * the behaviour models implement testing.
492         */
493        private void updateHistory(Outbreak outbreak) {
494                // Sampler sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
495                if (outbreak instanceof ModifiableOutbreak) {
496                        // This is always true BTW.
497                        var m = (ModifiableOutbreak) outbreak;
498                        var contactNetwork = contactNetwork(m);
499//                      Contact[][] contacts = contactNetwork.finaliseContacts();
500//                      Exposure[][] exposures = contactNetwork.finaliseExposures();
501
502                        // Update the next history entry with anything from the current
503                        var sampler1 = Sampler.getSampler();
504                        var nextOutbreakHistory = outbreak.getNextHistory()
505                                .get();
506                        m.getStateMachine()
507                                .performHistoryUpdate(
508                                        nextOutbreakHistory,
509                                        outbreak.getCurrentState(),
510                                        sampler1
511                                );
512
513                        m.getPeople()
514                                .parallelStream()
515                                .forEach(person -> {
516
517                                        var sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
518                                        var nextPersonHistory = person.getNextHistory()
519                                                .get();
520
521                                        if (person instanceof ModifiablePerson) {
522                                                var p = (ModifiablePerson) person;
523
524                                                var ref = p.getId();
525                                                nextPersonHistory
526                                                        .setTodaysContacts(contactNetwork.getContactsForId(ref))
527                                                        .setTodaysExposures(contactNetwork.getExposuresForId(ref));
528
529                                                p.getStateMachine()
530                                                        .performHistoryUpdate(
531                                                                nextPersonHistory,
532                                                                person.getCurrentState(),
533                                                                sampler
534                                                        );
535
536                                        }
537
538                                });
539                }
540        }
541
542        /**
543         * Creates the next model state factory, as a copy of current state and
544         * applies a chain of OutbreakUpdaters to pre-process the next state factory.
545         * Then applies the updates to each of the agents, then applies a chain of
546         * OutbreakUpdaters to post-process the next state factory. The pre and post
547         * processors can change the next state by modifying the state factory
548         *
549         * @param person the mutable holder for the immutable person state.
550         */
551        private void updateState(Outbreak outbreak) {
552
553                // This is a bit complex to order changes so that things are built in
554                // correct order.
555                // 1) make a new OutbreakState.Builder
556                // 2) copy current state into new history and make a set of
557                // PersonHistory.Builder
558                // 3) update PersonHistory.Builders with test results based on current
559                // state
560                // 4) update PersonHistory.Builders with contacts based on current state
561                // 5) switch the PersonHistory List with current step history from Builder
562                // 6) make a set of next state PersonState.Builders based on current state
563                // 7) update PersonState.Builders behaviour based on current step history
564                // 8)
565
566                var sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
567                var nextState = outbreak.getNextState()
568                        .get();
569                if (outbreak instanceof ModifiableOutbreak) {
570                        var m = (ModifiableOutbreak) outbreak;
571                        // Update the state machine (for the outbreak).
572                        m.getStateMachine()
573                                .performStateUpdate(nextState, m.getCurrentState(), sampler);
574
575                        // update nextState... pre-agent processing
576                        this.outbreakProcessors.forEach(p -> {
577                                if (p.getSelector()
578                                        .test(m)) {
579                                        p.getConsumer()
580                                                .accept(nextState, m, sampler);
581                                }
582                        });
583
584                        // agent processing
585                        m.getPeople()
586                                .parallelStream()
587                                .forEach(this::updateState);
588
589                }
590        }
591
592        /**
593         * Creates the next state factory, as a copy of current state and applies a
594         * chain of PersonUpdaters to the next state factory. The PersonUpdaters can
595         * change the next state by modifying the state factory
596         *
597         * @param person the mutable holder for the immutable person state.
598         */
599        private void updateState(Person person) {
600                // This is a thread local instance of sampler. so there should be one
601                // per thread. We shouldn't reset the seed though.
602                var sampler = Sampler.getSampler();
603                var nextState = person.getNextState()
604                        .get();
605                if (person instanceof ModifiablePerson) {
606                        var m = (ModifiablePerson) person;
607
608                        // Update the state machine (for the behaviour).
609                        // N.b. the state machine is not immutable, and holds context
610                        m.getStateMachine()
611                                .performStateUpdate(nextState, person.getCurrentState(), sampler);
612
613                        // What is the correct order here?
614                        // It feels like this should be done before the state update above for
615                        // each person but realistically it doesn't matter as the updates are
616                        // unaware of each others effects. The only thing that would have
617                        // changed is the individual's behaviour e.g. m.getStateMachine().
618
619                        nextState
620                                // Update the viral load model and the risk models.
621                                // These requires an up to date history for the exposures.
622                                .setInHostModel(
623                                        m.getCurrentState()
624                                                .getInHostModel()
625                                                .update(person, sampler)
626                                )
627                                .setRiskModel(
628                                        m.getCurrentState()
629                                                .getRiskModel()
630                                                .update()
631                                );
632
633                        // update nextState...
634                        this.personProcessors.forEach(p -> {
635                                if (p.getSelector()
636                                        .test(m)) {
637                                        p.getConsumer()
638                                                .accept(nextState, m, sampler);
639                                }
640                        });
641
642                }
643        }

645        /**
646         * This method allows you to add a outbreak processor to the update cycle.
647         * Outbreak processors are the final step to be run in updating an outbreak
648         * immediately before the agents in the outbreak are updated. When they
649         * operate the head of the history list will be at time (t) and the current
650         * state will also refer to time (t). However the policy state machine state
651         * will reflect time (t+1).
652         *
653         * @see Updater#withOutbreakProcessors(OutbreakStateUpdater...)
654         * @param test    A predicate that test whether the outbreak should be
655         *                updated. This could for example be a time based filter.
656         * @param updater An 3 parameter function referring to a outbreak state, the
657         *                current state, and a RNG sampler. An example here could
658         *                change the transmissibility of the outbreak at a set time.
659         * @return The updater ( a fluent method)
660         */
661        public Updater withOutbreakProcessor(
662                        Predicate<Outbreak> test,
663                        TriConsumer<ImmutableOutbreakState.Builder, Outbreak, Sampler> updater
664        ) {
665                this.outbreakProcessors
666                        .add(ModelOperation.updateOutbreakState(test, updater));
667                return this;
668        }
669
670        /**
671         * Outbreak processors are the final step to be run in updating an outbreak
672         * immediately before the agents in the outbreak are updated. When they
673         * operate the head of the history list will be at time (t) and the current
674         * state will also refer to time (t). However the policy state machine state
675         * will reflect time (t+1).
676         *
677         * @param updaters see
678         *                 {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.ModelOperation#updateOutbreakState(Predicate, TriConsumer)}
679         * @return the updater as a fluent method
680         */
681        public Updater withOutbreakProcessors(OutbreakStateUpdater... updaters) {
682                this.outbreakProcessors.addAll(Arrays.asList(updaters));
683                return this;
684        }
685
686        /**
687         * This method allows you to add a person processor to the update cycle.
688         * Person processors are the final step to be run in updating an person
689         * immediately before the final update. When they operate the head of the
690         * history list will be at time (t) and the current state will also refer to
691         * time (t). The in host model and risk model will have been updated to (t+1)
692         * but this will not yet have been applied to the current state. However the
693         * behaviour state machine state will reflect time (t+1).
694         *
695         * @see Updater#withPersonProcessors(PersonStateUpdater...)
696         * @param test    A predicate that test whether the person should be updated
697         * @param updater An 3 parameter function referring to a person state, the
698         *                current state, and a RNG sampler.
699         * @return The updater ( a fluent method)
700         */
701        public Updater withPersonProcessor(
702                        Predicate<Person> test,
703                        TriConsumer<ImmutablePersonState.Builder, Person, Sampler> updater
704        ) {
705                this.personProcessors
706                        .add(ModelOperation.updatePersonState(test, updater));
707                return this;
708        }
709
710        /**
711         * Person processors are the final step to be run in updating an person
712         * immediately before the final update. When they operate the head of the
713         * history list will be at time (t) and the current state will also refer to
714         * time (t). The in host model and risk model will have been updated to (t+1)
715         * but this will not yet have been applied to the current state. However the
716         * behaviour state machine state will reflect time (t+1).
717         *
718         * @param updaters see
719         *                 {@link io.github.ai4ci.flow.mechanics.ModelOperation#updatePersonState(Predicate, TriConsumer)}
720         * @return the updater as a fluent method
721         */
722        public Updater withPersonProcessors(PersonStateUpdater... updaters) {
723                this.personProcessors.addAll(Arrays.asList(updaters));
724                return this;
725        }
726}
